0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The determined naturalist has a small, furry problem for you to solve.

24.original: Speak with the vocal varmint and have the pair accompany you.

25.original: Speak with the determined naturalist while accompanied by the vocal varmint and its companion.

48.original: Well, I never... To think I'd run into you in Tuliyollal of all places. I'm from the Studium's Faculty of Biology. I've seen you before, back in Old Sharlayan!

49.original: Ah, that reminds me. You'll have to forgive the impertinence, but there just so happens to be a matter I could use your help with... I'm researching Turali ecosystems, and I'm currently on the hunt for one creature in particular.

50.original: In truth, I'd barely set foot on land before I made my discovery. Alas, as I was trying to secure the specimen for study, it got away from me...

51.original: It has a somewhat...peculiar cry, to say the least. The creature itself is covered in tawny brown fur and is rather small in stature. The strangest thing is, I asked some of the locals whether they had heard of such an animal, and they seemed quite baffled!

52.original: You don't happen to know of the creature I speak of, do you?

54.original: I daren't speak of such a vicious beast.

55.original: Sounds like a giant beaver to me.

56.original: I'm just as baffled as the locals. Never heard of such a creature.

58.original: You've laid eyes on the creature!? And a valiant hero such as yourself is in awe of its ferocity? Why, I must get my hands on it at all costs!

59.original: <hex:021A020203>Giant<hex:021A020103>, you say!? I should very much like to behold such grandeur with my own eyes!

60.original: It's surprising that one so well traveled would not have come across the creature. Which suggests that it is indeed a rare specimen of the highest order─and thus science demands it be captured and studied!

61.original: Aha! You mean to discern the animal's habitat and mannerisms by imitating its cry? Quite remarkable. It seems I'm in the presence of a budding naturalist! Well, I shan't be outshone in my own field! The creature must be captured!

62.original: I shall conduct an extensive search of the port, which is where I first saw the creature. Might I ask you to search the high ground─the residential district known as the Resplendent Quarter?

63.original: I shall continue my search in the vicinity. Now that I think of it, the creature itself may have come here from foreign shores...

65.original: The vocal varmint and its companion seem willing to follow you. Lead the pair back to the determined naturalist at High Tide Harbor.

66.original: The vocal varmint and its companion are now accompanying you. Keep them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.

67.original: You can leave your quest companions behind by entering a different area, or by speaking with them and selecting the option to part ways.

68.original: If you wish to have your companions join you again, return and speak with them at the original location.

69.original: You must be accompanied by the vocal varmint and its companion, and have them at your side in order to proceed with quest objectives.

70.original: Your companions have yet to arrive. Be sure they are at your side before attempting to continue.

76.original: Are you sure you wish to part ways with your companions?

78.original: The vocal varmint and its companion seem willing to wait for you in the Resplendent Quarter. Return to them when you are ready.

80.original: Having patiently waited for your return, the vocal varmint and its companion seem eager to follow you once again.

81.original: B-Brilliant, simply brilliant! Not one, but <hex:021A020203>two<hex:021A020103>! I only spotted a single specimen earlier─little did I think there'd be another lurking nearby!

83.original: They both seem remarkably docile. What a marvelous stroke of luck to be reunited with my quarry so quickly. This rather vindicates my decision to travel all this way!

84.original: You see, our professor recently absconded, leaving me and my fellow researchers vying for the newly vacated position.

85.original: This is just what I need! If I can work this discovery into a paper, it will do wonders for my standing within the faculty─and put me one step closer to that tenured position!

86.original: Recently, my fellow researchers and I have been vying for a tenured position within the faculty. This discovery is exactly what I need to give me the upper hand during the selection process!

87.original: Suffice it to say, I'll be keeping a close eye on these two and tending to them with the utmost care. I can't wait to conduct a thorough study!
